headline: VAR from Manchester derby not given a Premier League game for upcoming weekend
description: The VAR who made an "error of judgement" in awarding a goal to Manchester City in Sunday's derby at Old Trafford has not been appointed to a Premier League game this weekend.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi leaves Richarlison out of Spurs' Carabao Cup squad for Liverpool clash
description: Roberto De Zerbi has turned down the chance to include Richarlison in Tottenham's squad for Tuesday's Carabao Cup tie at Liverpool.

headline: Ex-Man United striker Wayne Rooney: 'Baffling' that VAR awarded Erling Haaland goal
description: Former Manchester United striker Wayne Rooney said it was "baffling" VAR awarded Erling Haaland's winner in the Manchester derby.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal keeping tabs on Liverpool teen Ngumoha
description: Arsenal are watching developments between Liverpool and Rio Ngumoha with interest. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Manchester derby defined by VAR drama; Real Madrid booed; Chelsea bullied by Hull
description: Sunday's Manchester derby was fascinating and not just because of the referee/VAR errors. Also: Real Madrid get booed again, and Chelsea should be worried after being bullied by Hull City, as Gab Marcotti recaps the weekend.
